content: Deleted in Bladder Cancer Protein 1 (DBC1) is a protein encoded by the DBC1 gene in humans. This gene is located on chromosome 9, specifically at the 9q32-33 region. This chromosomal region is notable for frequently exhibiting loss of heterozygosity in cases of transitional cell carcinoma of the bladder. The DBC1 gene contains a CpG island in its 5' region, which is thought to be a common site for hypermethylation. Such hypermethylation may lead to the silencing of this gene in certain bladder cancers. Although the precise functions of the DBC1 gene remain unknown, and it has not yet been classified into a specific protein family or functional pathway, it is hypothesized to function as a tumor suppressor gene.
